text: High Priest Esling is a Nord and the leader of the Ternion Monks. He is found in Mistwatch along with the rest of the monks.
Hilka is a Nord soldier of the Pact who has been captured by the Lion Guard in The Lion's Den.
Himalla is a Khajiit residing inside the Clanmother's House in S'ren-ja.
Himalzur is a Khajiit soldier and member of the Aldmeri Dominion found in Eagle's Strand. He has no unique dialogue.
Himarit is a Nord found in Riften. She, along with Adord and Ganariss have escaped Northwind Mine after the Reachmen occupied it.
Himela Chow-Master is a Nord chef working at The Sloshing Tankard in Northpoint.
Hingaron is a Bosmer found in Riften, Rawl'kha and Evermore. He will comment when the crafted items are delivered.
Hergor the Fallen is a powerful Wraith found in the ruins of Rulanyil's Fall.

Hierem was a greatly influential Nibenese Imperial with ties to several powerful factions, and serves as one of the primary antagonists of and . He served under both Thules the Gibbering and Titus Mede I during the Fourth Era. His physical form was described in 4E 48 as a pudgy man with thick eyebrows and mild blue eyes. He came from an old Nibenese family with a lot of connections.

High Priestess Solgra is a female Orsimer working at the Temple of Ire. She leads the city's worship of Trinimac. In her early life, she was a member of the Mages Guild in Wayrest, and during those years, she embarked on a journey through southern Tamriel, ending up in the Summerset Isles. At that point in life, she was converted to the Trinimac belief and set out to Orsinium out of a feeling of duty.
Heratir is an Altmer soldier located in Morkuldin Haven, near its northern entrance. He has no unique dialogue.
High Lord Torinaan, also known as Torinaan the Foresailor, was an Aldmer who lived during the Merethic Era. He is credited with discovering the Summerset Isles and founding the city of Firsthold.

High Priest Uluscant was an Ayleid priest dedicated to the worship of Hermaeus Mora. He was known to have resided in Bisnensel during the early First Era, where he spread the worship of Mora to much of the city's citizens.
Hinhad is a Redguard residing in Abah's Landing, Hew's Bane.
Hereld Malloni is a Breton found wandering the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast. She cannot be interacted with.
Herenia is an Imperial found inside the castle in Anvil. She cannot be interacted with.
Herd Mother was a divine animist spirit worshiped by Yokudan herding clans of Akos Kasaz on Yokuda and the Horsemen on Tamriel. She served as their guiding and protective deity.
Hides-the-Ashes is an Argonian Shadowscale in . She is looking for her mentor in the Cradle of Shadows.
High Kinlord Rilis VII is an Altmer spirit part of the long-lasting Rilis family found in the catacombs of their castle in Auridon.
Hester Missonnier is a Breton residing inside Jamadin's house in Abah's Landing.
Highland Archer is a bandit character residing in Hew's Bane.
Highland Enforcer is a bandit character residing in Hew's Bane.
Hervil Seryiil is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is stationed in Fort Virak.
Hildessa Hard-Heart is a Nord member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed at Fort Virak.
Herminia Pevengius is an Imperial member of the Order of the Hour. She is found at the Enclave of the Hourglass.
Herminius Andus is an Imperial found inside the Sewer Tenement. He is one of the assassination targets involved in the contract taking place there. He can be found in the southwestern square room.
Hilo Veturius is an Imperial member of the Worm Cult. He is part of the cell encountered at Trolhetta.
Hergarda is a Nord hired as a guard at the Fulstrom Homestead.
Heritance Chillrender is a generic Chillrender residing in locations in .

High Ordinator Vermethys Indoril is a Dunmer soldier of House Indoril, serving as the leader of the Militant Ordinators, a military branch of the Tribunal Temple alternatively known as the "Order of War." She is found within the Hall of Justice in the Temple Canton of Vivec City. Vermethys is also the author of the books Crafting Motif 49: Militant Ordinator Style and A Guide to Liturgical Vestments.
Heritance Sorcerer is an enemy in , and can be found in Aldmeri Dominion territory.
The Highland Soldier is a generic Imperial enemy soldier in . They are members of the Colovian Highlands and are hostile towards the Vestige, unless they wear a Disguise.
The Highland Marauder is a generic Imperial enemy marauder in . They are members of the Colovian Highlands and are hostile towards the Vestige, unless they wear a Disguise.
The Highland Ranger is a generic Imperial enemy ranger in . They are members of the West Weald Legion and are hostile towards the Vestige, unless they wear a Disguise.
The Highland Sentry is a generic Imperial enemy sentry in . They are members of the Colovian Highlands and are hostile towards the Vestige, even if they wear a Disguise.
Hilaire Falbert is a Breton laborer and member of the Fighters Guild residing at the local guildhall in Windhelm, Eastmarch.

High Councilor Meriath is a House Redoran councilor encountered in the Redoran Garrison during the quest Family Reunion. She walks in on the Vestige, Naryu Virian and the seemingly dead Veya Releth. She gives you an opportunity to leave and make up a story for the dead soldiers and the murdered Councilor Eris.
Hermrek is a Breton who can be found in the Illumination Academy in Summerset.
Hiranesse is a Altmer residing at the entrance Wasten Coraldale, Summerset.

The Hero of Dawnstar is the protagonist of , responsible for defending Dawnstar against the Ice Tribes and the Gehenoth Thriceborn around the year 3E 427, as well as rooting out a traitor to the Empire.
Hilo Sylla is an Imperial residing in Rimmen. He can be found at the Baandari Caravan Stop, near the Rimmen Wayshrine.
Hinsora is a Khajiit noble residing in Zansora's House in Rimmen.
High King Svargrim is the Nordic Jarl of Solitude and the High King of Western Skyrim. He can be found in the city's Blue Palace with his wife, Queen Gerhyld, and their daughter, Svana.
Herbsniffer is a Khajiit that has taken shelter, like most of the other residents, within the Elinhir sewers away from the renegade Blackcaster Mages Guild.
Hestra Verrucosus is an Imperial academic residing near the Bog Brokers marketplace at northern Lilmoth.
Hilda is a creature in that is a part of the Pets of Skyrim Creation Club content.

Hervod is a Nord in located on the north side of the river east of Treva's Farm in the Rift during the quest "Salty Meats." He is intoxicated and drinking a mug of ale by various supplies and wearing a stevedore's jerkin.
Hirtel is an Altmer commoner and refugee from Kvatch. Unlike most refugees, he has moved to Anvil instead of living in the refugee camp outside of Kvatch.
Hirarend is a Dunmer Scout and Ashlander living in Erabenimsun Camp in the Molag Amur region in Morrowind.
Hjoldir is a Nord merchant in Dagon Fel. He can be found wandering the town, and is armed with an Iron Tanto should anything go awry. Despite his class, Hjoldir does not barter.
Hjotra the Peacock is a Nord Pawnbroker found at End of the World Renter Rooms in Dagon Fel. She has a small inventory of various items for sale.

Hlidara Mothril is an Altmer who is the chaplain and chief advisor of Countess Alessia Caro, Countess of Leyawiin. Though she supports Alessia Caro's policy of moving Leyawiin towards more prominence in the Empire, Hlidara is less than pleased with her views on Argonians and Khajiits. She can be found in the dining area of Castle Leyawiin at around 8 pm, and follows Alessia Caro all day wherever she goes, including during the Countess' monthly pilgrimage to Chorrol. If the Countess dies, Hlidara will spend nearly all her time sleeping except for a four-hour meal in the dining hall.

Hirrus Clutumnus is an Imperial commoner who tries to live a normal life in Crucible, in New Sheoth. Once he sees the Hero in Crucible, he will do whatever he can to get their attention and ask for their help.
Hlofgar is a Nord Barbarian and a fugitive who is hiding in Bloodmayne Cave. He is a criminal who broke out of the Bravil prison with Ashanta, Dreet-Lai, and Enrion.
Hod is a Nord lumberjack residing in the town of Riverwood. He is typically found at the mill or his house.
Hlaren Ramoran is a Dunmer Knight in Morrowind who serves as a Councilor for House Redoran and the lord of Gnisis.
Hirnir is a Nord Barbarian who resides in Bal Fell, Morrowind. He is located with a group of Nords and a Dunmer.

Hisin Deep-Raed is a Nord who resides in Morrowind. He can be found in the West Gash region, west of Ald'ruhn. He has been paralyzed by a witch, so even if he is attacked, he will not be able to fight back.
Hlar is a Nord who resides in Onnissiralis, Morrowind. Hlar is a worshipper of Sheogorath.

Hoki is a Nord who resides in Ald'ruhn, Morrowind. Hoki is a member of the Morag Tong. He can be found in the Ald'ruhn guildhall. He also offers training in Acrobatics, Light armor, and Sneak. He may being willing to donate to the Buckmoth alms depending on his Disposition.

Holmgeira is a Nord barbarian who resides outside of the door to the Daedric shrine Addadshashanammu. She is the only non-hostile there. She wears Bonemold armor, including the cuirass, the left and right pauldrons, the greaves, and the boots. She is carrying an enchanted steel mace.
Hjornskar Head-Smasher is a Nord warrior and an officer of the Stormcloaks as well as the commander of the Whiterun Stormcloak Camp.
Holgeir was a warlord in the forests of Skyrim before the dragons returned.
Hofgrir Horse-Crusher is a Nord and the owner of the Riften Stables, just outside of Riften.
Hoddreid was a Nord bandit wizard. She was one of the Hunters of Hircine sent to kill Sinding, but was killed by him instead. Her corpse can be found inside Bloated Man's Grotto.

Hlevala Madalvel is a Dunmer Warrior and a Kinsman of House Hlaalu who resides in her home on the Dren Plantation. She is the foreman of the plantation and is in possession of the key needed to free Orvas Dren's slaves.

Hjalmer was the second known ruler of Skyrim. He was the eldest living son of Harald, the first known ruler of Skyrim. Hjalmer became king of Skyrim in 1E 221, after his father Harald died, when the first ever Moot was convened. He didn't reign long, as he died the following year in 1E 222, of unknown reasons. His younger brother, Vrage, became the next High King.
Hlenil Neladren is a Dunmer Spellsword, and member of Great House Hlaalu, who can be found in Vivec City, Curio Manor.
Hlaroi Faryon is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the Vivec, St. Olms Canton.
Hlavora Sadas is a Dunmer commoner who resides in the Vivec, Redoran Canton.
Hlendrisa Seleth is a Dunmer who resides in Seleth's House at Tel Uvirith.
Hleras Gidren is a Dunmer Commoner who resides at his house in the city of Sadrith Mora.
Hloris Farano is a Dunmer monk who resides in the chambers of the Telvanni Council House in Sadrith Mora.
Hjalfar is a Nord sailor found indoctrinated under Miraak's control on Solstheim.
Holmar is a Nord who lives in Godsreach. He can be found inside The Winged Guar.
Hloggar the Bloody is a Nord barbarian and member of House Hlaalu in . He can be found in the West Sewers of Old Mournhold which run beneath the Godsreach district of Mournhold.

Hoknir is a Nord hunter in who resides on Bleakrock Isle. He can be found near Deathclaw's Lair. He was seriously injured in a recent battle with Deathclaw and was forced to use parts of his leather to make a tourniquet.

Hisal is a Redguard ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed and once the ghosts have returned to the temple. He does not offer any dialogue.
Hlaki Lodorrsbane is a Draugr champion of the Hall of the Dead public dungeon. Killing him counts towards the "Hall of the Dead Vanquisher" and "Hall of the Dead Conquerer" achievements.
Hizala is a Khajiit chef. She works at the Salted Wings Tavern in Vulkhel Guard.
Hlethena Vando is a Dunmer member of House Hlaalu residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood.
Hjarfi Winter-Mane is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. She is the hall steward of their guildhall at the Redfur Trading Post.
Hisolda is a Redguard residing in Crosswych, Glenumbra. She is found at the Crosswych Inn, selling her wares.

Holgunn One-Eye is a Nord member of the Ebonheart Pact. He is the commanding Pact officer in Davon's Watch, having gained his rank from being a veteran of the Akaviri Invasion. He is heavily involved in the Stonefalls questline. Later on, he joins the Alliance Expeditionary Force to Coldharbour.
Hjolfrod Is a Nord working at the dockyards in Davon's Watch.
Hjognar is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. He is the hall steward of their guildhall in Kozanset.
Hjarl Fireforge is a Nord working at the Royal Bazaar in Mournhold.
Hleseth Dalothran is a Dunmer grocer. He sells his wares at his stall, Hleseth's Wagon of Flavor, in the bazaar of Belkarth.
Hjarkulf is a Nord part of the group of outlaws found inside the refuge in Belkarth.
Hlura Llarvys is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. He is the hall steward of their branch in Hallin's Stand.
Hladvyr Llarys is a Dunmer member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Ebonheart.
Hirish is a Khajiit slave and patron of The Sugar-Rot Slop House in the pens of Kragenmoor.
Hlarei Althranis is a Dunmer commoner afflicted by the Llodos Plague. He resides in the Flan House in Quarantine Serk.
Hlava Areloth is a Dunmer commoner residing at the Flan House in the town of Quarantine Serk, Deshaan.
Hloelott Ravens-Beak is a Nord member of the Undaunted. She is found at their enclave in Wayrest.
Hloenor Chill-Owl is a Nord member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed in Fort Amol.
Hokurek is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact residing in Fort Amol.
Hissmir Guard is a character residing in Hissmir, Shadowfen.
Hjarda Goldenhand is a Nord residing in the city of Windhelm.
Holsin Snow-Mane is a Nord residing in the city of Windhelm.
Hixulvutar is an Argonian member of the Undaunted found in their enclave in the Elden Root.
Hizdak is a Khajiit member of the Aldmeri Dominion. He is found in Eagle's Strand.

Hizurrdo is a deceased Khajiit found in the catacombs beneath Greenhill. He was the mate of Ezreba. The Stonefire Cult kidnapped him in order to force her into helping them accomplish their plans concerning the town. Once he outlived his usefulness, his captors disposed of him.
Hjagir is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact that was sent to investigate the Spider threat in Hightide Hollow.
Hlandria is a Dunmer Ashlander of the Mabrigash Tribe. She is found in their village located in the Vale of the Ghost Snake. She has a strong passion for guar.
Hlenia Faren is a Dunmer and the wife of Davenas Faren, the owner of Davenas Farm.
Hlenir Redoran was a Dunmer of House Redoran. His corpse can be found inside the Triple Circle Mine.
Holguss Coldheart is a Nord miner working in the Lost Knife Cave.
Hollow-Leg is a Nord woodworker. He sells his wares at his stall, Hollow-Leg's Weaponry, at the Shadowfen Markets in Stormhold.

Holsgar is a Nord in who is found in Bleakrock Village. His wife is Maesa, the village blacksmith. Holsgar can be found drinking stout while walking between the bar in the Trading Hall and the statue in the central square. He is killed during Covenant assault on village.
Holstagg the Black is a Nord warrior found at the Dragonstar Arena.
Holvur Antler-Fur is a Nord innkeeper and the husband of Deldwine Antler-Fur. He works at her inn in Fort Amol.
Hollow Guardian is a creature that appears in . Originally created as a replication of Sumiril by the Wilderking, this creature defends the Wilderking's Court.

Hoag Stormcloak, also known as the Great Bear of Eastmarch, was the father of Ulfric Stormcloak and the leader of the Stormcloak Clan. He is known to have had a more tolerant approach to the non-Nordic population of Windhelm than his son, who banned the Argonian population from living within the city walls. He died in 4E 183, while Ulfric was imprisoned due to his involvement in the Markarth Incident. Due to his incarceration, Ulfric was unable to attend the funeral, and had to smuggle his eulogy for his father out of prison in the form of a letter.
Hlavora Rothan is a Dunmer member of the Ebonheart Pact found in Davon's Watch. She can be seen celebrating upon completion of the quest "City Under Siege."
Hist Sentry Powaj is an Argonian residing inside Zasha-Ja's House in Ebonheart.
Hlogling is a Nord member of the Ebonheart Pact stationed in Jorunn's Stand.

Hojard is a Nord initially found trapped by the Stormfist Brigade inside The Bastard's Tomb. He will task the Vestige with freeing him from them. Upon being freed, he makes his way to Jorunn's Stand, where he joins the Ebonheart Pact.
Hiyyara is a Redguard innkeeper. She is the proprietor of Hew's Mane in Abah's Landing.
Hjolvara is a Nord drunkard found in the Brewers and Fishmongers Hall of the Saint Olms Waistworks in Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue.
Hoagding Owlcloak is a Nord patron of the Loose Tooth Lodge at the Stonetooth Fortress.
Hogondar Hammerhurl is a Nord member of the Undaunted. He is part of the team that went into the portal leading to Mehrunes Dagon's Deadlands that opened up in the City of Ash.
Hlenil Sadryon is a Dunmer scholar of the Tribunal Temple residing in Gnisis on Vvardenfell. He is located in the Gnisis Temple. He has no unique dialogue.
Hlevala Ryon is a Dunmer farmer residing in Balmora. She can be found near the southern square, feeding bantam guars or standing near the well. She has no unique dialogue.
Hjoag is a Nord commoner residing in Balmora, in Vvardenfell.
Hired Assassin is a Dunmer Assassin encountered near the Rethan Manor in . She was hired by Malur Rethan to kill his brother, Benar Rethan, and Vestige.
Hleran Champion is a Dunmer ghost and Hleran family ancestor residing in Hleran Ancestral Tomb.
Hleran Footman is a Dunmer ghost and Hleran family ancestor residing in Hleran Ancestral Tomb.
Hleran Noble is a Dunmer ghost and Hleran family ancestor residing in Hleran Ancestral Tomb.

Hlavora Fedos is a Dunmer residing outside the Canton of St. Delyn the Wise in Vivec City. She may be found holding a conversation with Nephothal and Sadas Vidron, after which she will enter the Saint Delyn Waistworks. However, she cannot be found inside.
Hoarse Voice, as Mere-Glim called him because of his hoarse voice, was a sailor working in the Tsonashap. His real name is unknown.

Hollow Watchman is the leader of the Hollow forces at Shadows Crawl. He was ordered to prevent anyone from settling in the ruins when he was created, and must follow his duties in not allowing Clan Driladan to settle there.
Hirenariel is an Altmer merchant working at the branch of The Ruins Bazaar near the overlook south of Shimmerene.
Hodmar Iron-Kettle is a deceased Nord found in Mud Tree Village. Examining his corpse triggers the quest, "A Last Reminder."

Hofgrad Kjisorssen is a Nord residing in The Stitches in Northern Elsweyr. His unseen master had three bottles of wine stolen from him and must return them in order to free himself from his servitude.
Hleezeireeus is an Argonian servant residing in Lord Drono's Townhouse in Balmora.
Hirmond is a Nord residing in the Gladiator's Quarters outside of Solitude.
Hlokela is a Nord residing in the Solitude Fighters Guild in Solitude.
Hitari is a Redguard armswoman who runs Hitari's Armaments in Lilmoth located outside of the Guild Hall.
Hitoufah is a traveling Redguard merchant in . She is found on the road between Hallin's Stand and Yanurah's Respite in Bangkorai.
Honditar is an Altmer hunter, forester, and mountain man. He is a Journeyman Athletics Trainer as well. Honditar lives in a wooden house next to Chorrol's walls to the southwest of the town.

Honmund is a Nord scout and explorer residing in Bruma. He is living with his female partner Alga in Honmund's House. Honmund will sometimes go on an expedition to harvest clouded funnel caps, outside of Bruma.
Horulia Jannus is an Imperial who resides in Maelkashishi, Morrowind.

Honthjolf is a Nord who resides in Aharnabi, Morrowind. He is a former member of the Imperial Legion, but deserted and is now hated by the army. Frald the White will send the Nerevarine to kill Honthiolf. He knows that the Legion is after him and will attack anyone on sight.
Horstar Home-Wrecker is a Nord Barbarian who spends his days worshiping Molag Bal in Ramimilk, Morrowind.
Horm is a Nord citizen who resides at Katla's Farm outside of Solitude.

Horik Halfhand is a Nord warrior in who lives in Dawnstar. He serves as a housecarl and bodyguard to Brina Merilis, and can be found inside The White Hall once certain quest requirements are fulfilled on the Imperial Quest Line.

Horkvir Bear-Arm is a Nord blacksmith who resides in the Shivering Isles town of Split. Horkvir shares the town with his Mania counterpart who lives in the other half of town. Despite the two looking alike they are completely different in attitudes and personality.

Hosgunn Crossed-Daggers was a Fourth Era Jarl of Riften. He was appointed as Jarl in 4E 98 after the death of the previous Jarl during the Void Nights. He ruled for 31 years with an iron fist, taxing his citizens mercilessly. It was not until 4E 129 when the citizens rose up against him. They succeeded, in a short war which left much of Riften in ruins.
Hort Ledd was one of the former Incarnates of the Nerevarine. As a failed incarnate, he resides in the Cavern of the Incarnate to help the present Incarnate of the Nerevarine during his or her quest.
Homraz gra Morgrump is an Orsimer thief, who was originally planned to reside in Chorrol. Homraz does not exist in-game, and can only be spawned through console commands.
Horski Tallowhand is a Nord warrior who resides in the Skaal Village.
Hops-Over-Fires is an Argonian merchant residing in the city of Mournhold.
Homeira is a Redguard member of the Fighters Guild residing in the guildhall in the town of Bergama.
Hossid at-Amjad is a Redguard residing in the city of Sentinel. He can be found in Sisters of the Sands Inn.
Horatius Mento is an Imperial residing in the city of Windhelm.
Honai is a Redguard armorer and member of the Daggerfall Covenant residing at the Northern High Rock Gate. She can be found at the Armory Merchants, selling her wares.
Honest-Feet is an Argonian worshipper of Sanguine found in Sanguine's Demesne.
Hooks-Fish is an Argonian from the Silent Mire seeking help from the soldier at Tal'Deic Fortress concerning the Khajiit pirates attacking the village.
Horatia Russus is an Imperial guard protecting the priestess of Mara found near Fort Sphinxmoth.
Horvantud the Fire Maw is a Daedroth that appears in . They can be found in the City of Ash II in Greenshade.
Horatia Iulus is an Imperial weaponsmith. She sells her wares at the Anvil Ironworks and Tannery in Anvil.
Honrid the Magnificent is a Nord entertainer found performing on the streets of Anvil, Gold Coast. He has no unique dialogue.
Hort Selaro is a Dunmer student in who resides at Ladrasa's House in Dhalmora.
Horatius Cento is an Imperial residing in Cheydinhal. He is located behind a wall near the western gate, in the area controlled by the rebellion.
Hort Andoren is a Dunmer found in Vivec City during Divine Disaster.
Houndsman Brute is a character in that is a member of the Houndsmen.
Houndsman Heartwood is a character in that is a member of the Houndsmen.
Houndsman Longbranch is a character in that is a member of the Houndsmen.
Houndsman Mystic is a character in that is a member of the Houndsmen.
Houndsman Scout is a character in that is a member of the Houndsmen.
Houndsman Sharpshooter is a character in that is a member of the Houndsmen.
Hoonzo-Gann, the Creeping Chill is a Xivkyn in . She may be found patrolling the Imperial City Sewers. She primarily uses ranged and AoE attacks.
Honorable Yngmaer Raven-Quill is a Nord residing in the Bards College in Solitude.
Hour Guard is a generic guard serving Grand Chanter Surus and his Society of the Dragon as part of the Order of the Hour.

Hreirek the Lean is a Nord thief and a Wet Ear with the Thieves Guild. She offers her services as a thieves' tools merchant and a skill trainer at The End of the World in Dagon Fel, Morrowind. Hreirek wears a set of Netch Leather Armor and wields a Silver Viperblade.
Ibarnadad Assirnarari is a Dunmer alchemist who sells potions, ingredients, and alchemy apparatus in his shop in Suran.
Hrordis is a Nord Sorcerer living in the Ascadian Isles region of Vvardenfell. She can be found at the Halfway Tavern in Pelagiad, Morrowind.
Huurwen is a Bosmer member of the Anvil Fighters Guild, and is also a Block Trainer that offers an Apprentice level training skill.
Humilis Nonius is an Imperial commoner working at the Wildeye Stables just outside Bruma.
Hunting Tail is an Argonian sharpshooter and worshiper of the Daedric Prince Hircine who can be found at the Shrine of Hircine. He will start the Daedric Quest when the Hero speaks to him.
Ian is a Redguard member of the Fighters Guild residing in Ebonheart.
Hrundi is the Fighters Guild guildmaster in Sadrith Mora. He can be found in the Sadrith Mora Fighters Guild located on the ground floor of Wolverine Hall in Vvardenfell.
Hrargal the Crow is a Nord who resides in Dren Plantation, Morrowind. They are a member of House Hlaalu.
Hurnfing is a Nord Battlemage who resides in Assalkushalit, Morrowind.
Hylf the Harrier is a Nord barbarian who resides in the Black Shalk Cornerclub, located within the Vivec, Foreign Quarter.
Hroki is a Nord residing in Markarth. Hroki can be found during the day at the market stalls inside the gates. She works at the Silver-Blood Inn, which is operated by her parents, Frabbi and Kleppr.

Hrongar is a Nord warrior living in Whiterun. He is the younger brother of Balgruuf the Greater. He often gets into disagreements with the Jarl's steward, Proventus Avenicci. Hrongar can usually be found sitting at the table in Dragonsreach, eating, or aimlessly walking the halls.
Hulda is a Nord innkeeper and the owner of The Bannered Mare in Whiterun.
Hreinn is a Nord citizen who lives in the city of Markarth. He can be found working at the Silver-Blood Inn, which is operated by his parents, Frabbi and Kleppr.

Hunroor was a Nord warrior. He is a hero, and his ghost can be found inside the Hall of Valor in Sovngarde. He, Nikulas, and Erlendr were turned into a stone pillar at Brodir Grove by the wizard Grimkell while searching for Sovngarde. Ulfgar the Unending later avenged them by killing Grimkell. Hunroor and his companions eventually did find Sovngarde.
Hroar is a Nord orphan living in the Honorhall Orphanage in Riften, as one of the victims of the cruelty of the disastrously misnamed headmistress, Grelod the Kind.
Ibanammu Assutladainab is a Dunmer who resides at Kaushtababi Camp on Azura's Coast.

Ibasour Sershurrapal is a Dunmer Barbarian residing in a small camp near Andalen Ancestral Tomb in the Azura's Coast region of Morrowind. He shares the campsite with Sannit Kil and Assatlit Assudnilamat.

Hrolfdir was the Jarl of Markarth during the Markarth Incident in 4E 174. He is the father of Markarth's Jarl Igmund, and brother of his former steward Raerek, who now serves as steward for Jarl Igmund.

Huna was a Nedic hoplite who was one of the companions of Pelinal Whitestrake during the Alessian Slave Rebellions in Cyrodiil during the First Era. Originally a slave who collected grain for the Ayleids, who ruled Cyrodiil and had enslaved the Imperials, Huna was eventually freed from their bondage by Pelinal Whitestrake and trained to become a hoplite, or spearman. Eventually, Whitestrake and Huna developed a relationship, and it was said that Whitestrake loved Huna. In 1E 242, Huna was killed by the arrows of Celethelel the Singer. Huna's death drove Whitestrake to madness, and led to him rampaging across Cyrodiil, destroying many Ayleid cities including Narlemae and Celediil.
Hyarnarenquar is an Altmer witchhunter, and worshipper of Mehrunes Dagon residing in the shrine Assurnabitashpi. He is hostile and attacks the Nerevarine on sight.
Hulya is a Redguard residing in the city of Port Hunding. She works as a servant in Headman Bhosek's palace there.
Hunt-Wife Othikha is an Orsimer who resides in Betnikh. She is one of the characters found in King Renwic's vision.

Hrorleid is a Nord ghost found in the Temple of Mourning Springs after the quest "Tears of the Two Moons" has been completed and the ghosts have returned to the temple. She can be found kneeling before Skavwulf the Maul, with Ogmir and Belknar.

Hrogar is a Nord warrior who founded Hrogar's Hold. He is married to Edwina and has two sons, Gar and Bjorick. He sent the family dog named Horker and his merchant daughter Hedstild to Davon's Watch after a Dunmer priest assaulted her.
Hyalan is an Altmer residing in the Auridon city of Vulkhel Guard.

Hunt-Wife Lurgush is an Orsimer, and resides in the Stonetooth Fortress, on the island of Betnikh. She looks after the horses in the stable near the Stonetooth Smithy. She is also the hunt-wife of the Seamount Clan.
Husniya is a Redguard who resides in the city of Daggerfall, Glenumbra. She can be found at The Rosy Lion.
Huki Cold-Eye is a Nord found at the Stonetooth Fortress. She is sitting on a bench outside one of the smaller huts near the docks.
Hyandorril is an Altmer residing in Elden Root in the region of Grahtwood. He is a member of the Mages Guild.
Hranura is a Nord residing in Port Hunding, Stros M'Kai. She can be found wandering around town.
Hyna Dorn'ke is a Bosmer hunter who resides in the Ministry of Truth's Prison Keep above Vivec, Temple Canton.
Hroldar the Strange is a Nord barbarian who is guarding the entrance of the mine in the settlement of Raven Rock.
Hrantin is a Nord patron of The Fish Stink in Davon's Watch.
Huthak is a Khajiit brewer. He works at The Boatman's Tail in Mistral, the port city of Khenarthi's Roost.
Huki Seven-Swords is an unused character residing in the The Pit, a location accessible only through the use of console commands.
Hraelgar Stonecrush is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact found at their camp in Ebonheart.
Hranasgi is a Nord laborer residing in Vivec City. She has no unique dialogue.
Hreilund is a Nord student found inside the instruction halls of Shad Astula.
Hranir Icy-Mane is a Nord outlaw and member of the Undaunted. She is found at their enclave in Mournhold.
Hulbert Errard is a Breton patron of the Dead Wolf Inn in the city of Shornhelm.
Huet Bedel is a Breton blacksmith residing in the city of Shornhelm, Rivenspire. He can be found at the smithy, sells his wares.
Housecarl Thorulf is a Nord Worm cultist posing as the bodyguard of Unnvald Ironhand, the ruler of Fullhelm Fort.
Hraerfja is a Nord in who works at the Sky's Edge Tavern in Skywatch. She has no dialogue.
Hramdin Eversmiling is a deceased Nord in that is found at the Frostmoon Farmstead.
Hreilund Battle-Weary is a Nord member of the Mages Guild. He is found at their guildhall in Velyn Harbor.
Hroi Banner-Torn is a Nord chef. She sells her wares at her stall, Hroi's Hungry Corner, at the trading hall in Bleakrock Village.
Hrolvar is a Nord member of the Fighters Guild. He is the hall steward of their guildhall in Marbruk.
Hunt-Wife Thushleg is an Orsimer member of the Lhurgash Clan, and one of the wives of Warchief Gorzesh, the leader of the clan.
Hunts-in-Shadow is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild in who is found recovering from injuries sustained during "Dangerous Webs" at the Hunter's Camp on Bleakrock Isle.
Huntsman Davlinn is a Dremora devoted to Hircine found in The Hunting Grounds.
Huntsman Duneir is a Dremora devoted to Hircine found in The Hunting Grounds.
Huntsman Gamir is a Dremora devoted to Hircine found in The Hunting Grounds.
Huntsman Mar-Gamir is a Dremora devoted to Hircine found in The Hunting Grounds.
Hurabesh is an Orsimer carpenter who sells her wares at the Cold Iron Forge in the Hollow City.
Hurien is a Breton priest found in the Daggerfall Cathedral.
Huunel is a Bosmer blacksmith in who resides in the city of Vulkhel Guard, Auridon. She can be found in the Guard's Forge selling her wares.
Ianix is an Argonian enchanter selling her wares at her stall, Ianix, Enchanter, in Stormhold.
Ibelgast is a Spiderkith warrior and follower of Mephala found in the Crypt of Hearts II. He appears with Broodnurses, Cauterizers, and Wefters.

Ibrula is a Redguard found in the ruins of The Seeker's Archive. She is attempting to gain access to the library on the behalf of the Star-Gazers. She is the author of Crafting Motif 20: Yokudan Style.
Hul-Tei is an Argonian commoner residing in Kragenmoor. She can be located near the Kragenmoor Wayshrine, and has no unique dialogue.
The Hulking Scalon is a creature in . It is a form of Scalon.
Hydalion is an Altmer alchemist and member of the Mages Guild residing in the city of Orsinium, Wrothgar. He is the owner of Hydalion's Potions & Elixirs where he works with the help of Telarnel.
Hrefgerda is a Nord soldier of the Ebonheart Pact stationed in Fort Virak.
Bolgar or Hunt-Wife Bolgar is an Orsimer member of the Tumnosh Clan and a hunt-wife to the Chief Ramash, mother of Shabon.
Ianus Faleria was the second son of Lord Nunex Faleria and Lady Faleria. He fathered a son, Maxivian Faleria, with a merchant's daughter.
Hynendirre is an Altmer working at Pellingare Manor in Wayrest.
Hunts-in-Water is an Argonian patron of The Serpent and the Senche in Abah's Landing.
Hunts-with-Daggers is an Argonian member of the Fighters Guild. He is found at their branch in Abah's Landing.
Hunindir is a Bosmer scholar. He is part of a small team conducting research on the kwama found inside the Burroot Kwama Mine.
Hrolmir is an unused Nord in . He was supposed to make an appearance in the quest "The Pursuit," but was not added to the final version of the game.
Hugh'sMinotaurLord is a Minotaur used as a test creature in .

Hrerik Lodorrsbane is a powerful Draugr found within the Hall of the Dead of Windhelm. Killing this creature counts towards the "Hall of the Dead Vanquisher" and "Hall of the Dead Conquerer" achievements.
Huolde is a Nord New Life Festival celebrant who may be found south of Windhelm, Eastmarch.
